svg.title: Clawd sleep
svg.desc: Tucked into bed on the input box in a striped nightcap, thin sleepy lids shut: the quilt rises and falls with slow breaths, Zs float up under a twinkling moon, his firefly glows in a jar, and a snot bubble swells until it pops and he peeks over the quilt with one heavy-lidded eye, then dozes off again with a dreamy smile in his eyes.
